name: privatus-analytics
description: Read and manage your Privatus Analytics sites, stats, goals and testimonials.

interface.longDescription:
Privatus Analytics is web analytics for your own websites. This plugin lets you read and manage your Privatus Analytics account from ChatGPT: ask how your sites are doing in plain words and get the numbers back.

What it does:
- Website traffic: visitors, pageviews, bounce rate and visit duration for any period, compared with the period before, broken down by page, source, campaign, country or device.
- Conversions: goal completions and conversion rates, funnels and the paths visitors take before they convert.
- Live and insights: who is on your site right now, and the biggest changes since the last period.
- Site health: Web Vitals, SEO site audits and uptime checks.
- Testimonials: read, approve, reject, tag and organize the testimonials your customers send.
- With full access it can also create and edit goals, funnels, segments, chart notes, alerts and email reports.

Who it is for: website owners, marketers, founders and agencies who already use Privatus Analytics and want answers about their traffic without opening a dashboard.

Limitations:
- You need a Privatus Analytics account with at least one site that has the tracking script installed.
- It only sees the workspace you connect, and never does more than your own role allows. You choose read-only or full access when you connect.
- Deleting data and changes to members, access or security are never done from ChatGPT: the tool gives you a link to the page in Privatus Analytics where you do it yourself.
- Privatus Analytics is cookieless and stores no IP addresses or visitor identities, so it cannot tell you who a visitor was.
defaultPrompt: How did my website do last week compared with the week before?
Which pages and sources brought the most visitors this month?
How many visitors are on my site right now?

positive.prompt: Which websites do I track in Privatus Analytics?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sites of the connected workspace with their domains.

positive.prompt: How many visitors and pageviews did my busiest site get in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives visitors, visits, pageviews, bounce rate and visit duration for the last 30 days, with the change from the period before.

positive.prompt: What were the top 5 referrers to my site last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top 5 referrers with visitors and their share of the total.

positive.prompt: List my goals and their conversion rates this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each goal with completions and conversion rate for the month.

positive.prompt: Create a goal called Signup for visits to the page /welcome.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, creates a pageview goal for /welcome and returns its id and name.

negative.prompt: Delete my site and all of its data.
Tell me the IP address and name of the person who visited my features page.
Book me a flight to Lisbon next Friday.

publication.release_notes: First release: traffic stats, breakdowns, live visitors, insights, goals, notes and testimonial moderation for your Privatus Analytics workspace.
